verdicts.reason: Both are the same broken layout. The CTA is moved above the logo at the top, and the flavour names are stacked in reverse order, separated from descriptors that no longer match them (Honey Rosemary ends up paired with 'Bright & zesty'). One giant bag dominates the top, while two tiny unreadable bags sit stranded at the bottom with a dead gap above them and the third bag is missing; the text block is jammed into a dense centred stack. B is marginally less bad only because its CTA pill sits a little further from the top-left edge, whereas A's crowds the corner.
